body:

title: Prompt-cache TTL per agent role
brief: Parked: workers on 5m cache TTL, waiting sessions on 1h — operator deciding
body:
Claude Code gives a subscription's main session a 1-hour prompt-cache TTL (cache write 2× base input) and subagents/forks 5 minutes (1.25×); every lyx agent is a main session in tmux, so all of them write at the 1-hour price (see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-caching.md).

Measured on the `landing` run's transcripts: Discussion, Plan, Bouncer and Burler never paused more than 90 s between turns, so 5 minutes keeps them warm; ly-drive paused up to 508 s (three gaps over 5 minutes), so it needs 1 hour. Webster Master waits on forks via Monitor and is not yet measured.

Likely shape: shuttle sets `CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL=5m|1h` (Claude Code v2.1.242+) per role when it spawns a session, configurable per role. loomyard was developed with the 5-minute limit in mind, so 5 minutes matches its design assumption.

title: Trace logs: configurable retention, fewer files from routine commands
brief: Trace logs: configurable retention, fewer files from routine commands
body:
`.lyx/logs` gets one trace file per lyx invocation that logs at INFO+ or exits non-zero (`internal/logger/sink.go`); `internal/logger/retention.go` keeps the newest 50 files and nothing older than 14 days, both hard-coded.
Operator board upserts and fabric verbs fill the 50 slots, pushing a run's interesting traces out.
Options: make both bounds config keys; or arm the sink only on failure or when a trace id is set (loom runs, ly-drive steps).

title: lyx quarry: per-glyph resolve answers, grep-safe glyphs output
brief: lyx quarry: per-glyph resolve answers, grep-safe glyphs output
body:
- **One bad glyph sinks the whole `resolve` batch.** `lyx quarry resolve a b bad` returns only `{"error":"<bad>: not_found","ok":false}`, nothing for the valid glyphs. quarry itself answers per glyph; `internal/quarrycli/resolve.go` collects every non-found status and fails the whole invocation by design. A planner checking spellings wants one answer per glyph, with the bad one marked `not_found`.
- **`glyphs` output invites a broken grep.** A Plan-Write agent ran `lyx quarry glyphs internal/shedengine | grep -v "_test"` to drop test symbols; the JSON is pretty-printed one field per line, so the grep removed only each test symbol's `"file": ..._test.go` line and left the symbol without `file` (quarry#33, closed: quarry is correct). Give `lyx quarry glyphs` a flag that excludes test-file symbols, or emit one symbol per line, so the obvious filter is either unnecessary or correct.

Reported by the `operator-surface` Plan-Write session (2026-09-30).

title: Burler: warn when the explore stencil lacks the focus_directive marker
brief: Burler: warn when the explore stencil lacks the focus_directive marker
body: `internal/burlerengine/prompt.go`: friction warns when its stencil marker is missing (`friction.WarnIfMarkerAbsent`), but `{{.focus_directive}}` has no such check. Since #299 the focus directive no longer also rides `PriorReviews`, so a board explore stencil without the marker (dev build, operator-edited board copy) silently drops the Bouncer's focus from every Burler round. Add the same warning. Found in the #299 review.
